cues: The subnet mask says which bits name the network and which name the host.
Two five five dot two five five dot two five five dot nought: the first twenty four bits are network.
Set the host bits to nought for the network address, to all ones for the broadcast address.
That leaves two to the eight minus two, two hundred and fifty four usable hosts.
